The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 35f14f53ac82dc8a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 16. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Let X be a smooth connected projective complex variety with H0(X, Ωq X) = 0 for q > 0, and suppose that L = −KX has a smooth semipositive Hermitian metric. Let an algebraic torus T act on X, with its natural action on L. Let f : X 99K Z be a dominant T-invariant rational map to a smooth connected projective variety, where C(Z) is relatively algebraically closed in C(X). On a smooth projective resolution π : Y → X, fY : Y → Z, put LY = π∗L, EY = KY/X, and η = Spec C(Z). Suppose that: 1. H0(Yη, pLY |Yη )T ̸= 0 for some integer p > 0; 2. there is an integer a > 0 such that dimC(Z) H0 (Yη, (EY + mLY )|Yη )T = 1 for every positive multiple m of a. Then either H0(X, rL)T ̸= 0 for some r > 0, or there is a dominant rational map h : Z 99K W to a smooth connected projective variety with dim W < dim Z such that h ◦ f satisfies the same two conditions, possibly with different positive integers. The field C(W) is relatively algebraically closed in C(X).
